shortDescription: An earthquake of magnitude 6.16 struck the Vanuatu islands on Sunday, the German Research Centre for Geosciences (GFZ) said.The quake struck at a depth of 125 km (78 miles), the agency added.

children: An earthquake of magnitude 6.16 struck the Vanuatu islands on Sunday, the German Research Centre for Geosciences (GFZ) said.
The quake struck at a depth of 125 km (78 miles), the agency added.
